facts.fact: mHealth Africa (TICANALYSE) states that its mHealth community platform automatically transmits community-collected data (consultations, vaccinations, input management) to the national DHIS2 (SIGSANTE) through synchronisation mechanisms using HL7 FHIR and secure APIs, so two systems exchange data.

systems.owner: Health Information Directorate, Ministry of Health

note: as_of is the document's published date; it gives no date for when the synchronisation began.
